itineraries.intro: Calvi, Girolata and the red cliffs of Scandola.

The red islets and the market town.
The volcanic reserve from the water.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Calvi to Cala di Volpe
itineraries.intro: Ocean Independence’s classic: Corsica’s west coast, Bonifacio and across the strait to Sardinia.

days.note: The citadel over the bay and the long beach beneath the pines.
Napoleon’s birthplace and the Sanguinaires islands at sunset.
The Gulf of Valinco: prehistoric Filitosa inland and quiet beaches along the shore.
The citadel above the white cliffs.
The granite islets of the strait.
The Costa Smeralda; disembark in Olbia.
